stated_denial_reason: Criterion 1 (instability) not met because translation was 3.5 mm (requires 4 mm or 10 degrees); Criterion 5 (nicotine) not met because there was no negative cotinine test after 6 weeks of abstinence.
appeal_submission_method: Meridian Valley Health Plan, Appeals & Grievances, 3300 Valley Center Dr, Mesa Verde, ST 00000; fax (555) 010-7720. Peer-to-peer at (555) 010-7700.
summary: Prior auth for an L4-5 TLIF was denied on the instability and nicotine criteria. The flexion-extension films show 11 degrees of angular motion, which meets the policy's alternative threshold, but the cotinine result was pending.
